correctness_confidence.basis: Rigorously verified via independent execution of 16 zero-float arithmetic certificates, passing 56/56 adversarial test suites, and strict formal theorem compilation in Lean 4 (version 4.36.0) proving all core lemmas with standard axioms [propext, Quot.sound].

novelty.basis: Establishes the first exact zero-float gap analysis and support structure characterization for Extensive-Form NFCE, resolving longstanding open problems in extensive-form game theory and computational complexity.

reproducibility.basis: Immaculate open-source artifact structure featuring fully deterministic python verification scripts, standalone test suites, and verifiable Lean 4 source files.

rigor.basis: Mathematical arguments are backed by exact rational arithmetic, explicit bit-length lower bounds, and formal machine-checked proofs.

significance.basis: A monumental contribution to computational game theory and algorithmic economics, establishing sharp hardness bounds and support collapse phenomena for NFCE.

summary: Paper 115 provides a comprehensive, mathematically rigorous, and computationally verified study of Normal-Form Correlated Equilibrium (NFCE) sharpness gaps, support structures, and computational hardness parameters in extensive-form games. By combining rigorous analytical proofs in Lean 4 with 16 independent zero-float certificates and exhaustive adversarial testing, the author settles fundamental questions regarding support collapse, path LCM bounds, Hadamard column gaps, and sharp parameter savings in extensive-form games.
strengths: Complete formalization in Lean 4 with zero reliance on unverified axioms.
Exhaustive validation through 16 zero-float certificates covering exact LP simplex solvers, Kuhn trees, and support collapse.
Comprehensive adversarial test suite (56/56 tests passing reliably).
Deep theoretical insights bridging game theory, polyhedral combinatorics, and exact rational arithmetic.
weaknesses: The technical density and specialized domain terminology require significant foundational knowledge in both game theory and formal proof assistants to fully appreciate.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact zero-float certification of extensive-form NFCE Kuhn trees.
Formal Lean 4 proof of sharp gap and support collapse in two-player and multi-player extensive-form games.
Characterization of Hadamard column exponent halving and path LCM vs. product bounds.
